## Editing a module

A module is an ordinary file in the project package's `graphics/` folder.
You can edit it in any editor (**Open in Editor** in the Source section) or
with your own tools. Frame Job watches the folder: when a module, font or
picture changes, the paused preview redraws and the inspector updates within
a moment, and a playing preview picks the change up on its next frame.

The folder is created the first time something is written to it. Frame Job
also keeps `API.md` and `API.d.ts` there, the reference and its type
definitions, for an editor or an agent working in the folder. **Help ▸
Graphics Reference** opens the same reference in your default Markdown app,
with or without a project open.

In an untitled project, graphics are kept in a temporary folder and move into
the package when you first save it.

### Kept versions

Whenever Frame Job sees a module's code replaced while the project is open
(an agent's write, a save from your editor, a restore), it keeps the code
that was there. The last 10 versions of each module are kept in
`graphics/history/`. Leave that folder to Frame Job.

## Renaming, deleting and restoring graphics

The **File** menu has three items that each open a small sheet with a
**Graphic:** pop-up of the project's modules:

| Item | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Rename Graphic…** | Renames the module. Type a **New name:** (lowercase letters, digits and -). Every clip drawn by it, on the timeline and inside nests, follows the new name. The field starts with the chosen module's name and changes when you pick another; **Rename** stays disabled until the name is not empty and differs from the current one |
| **Delete Graphic…** | Deletes a module that no clip uses. Its code is kept, so it can be restored |
| **Restore Graphic Version…** | Puts back the newest kept version of a module's code, deleted modules included (listed as "name (deleted)"). The sheet says how many versions are kept |

Rename and Restore open on the selected clip's module when one clip is
selected. Delete always opens on the first module in the list.

- **Rename** is one undo step when a clip uses the module, and Undo renames
  the file back too. A module no clip uses is renamed back by renaming it
  again. Rename is refused if the new name isn't a module name, if a module
  of that name already exists, or if clips left behind by a deleted module of
  that name still use it. Rename is greyed while a nest is open.
- **Delete** is refused while any clip is drawn by the module, and the sheet
  names those clips: delete them or switch them to another module first.
  Fonts and pictures are left alone. Deleting is not an undo step.
- **Switching clips to another module**: the inspector can't point clips at
  a different existing module. **Duplicate as New Graphic…** only switches
  them to a new copy. To move clips to a module that already exists, delete
  the clips and insert that module again, or have an agent call
  `set_graphic` with `{clips, patch: {name}}`.
- **Restore** keeps the code it replaces, so restoring again returns to where
  you were. Restoring is not an undo step.

On success the sheet closes without a message. A refusal beeps and appears
in the sheet in Frame Job's own words, and the sheet stays open. Rename and Delete are greyed in a project with no graphics, and Restore
when no version of any graphic is kept.

*Agents:* `rename_graphic` (`name`, `to`), `delete_graphic` (`name`),
`restore_graphic` (`name`, and optionally a `revision` from `kept`, where the
menu always restores the newest).

## Showing video inside a graphic

A graphic can't read a video's pixels, but it can shape one. Put the graphic
on the track directly above the video and set that track to a matte with
**Track ▸ Matte**. The video then shows only where the graphic draws (or,
inverted, where it doesn't). See [Canvas and layers](canvas-and-layers.md)
for the matte modes and the
[API reference](../graphics-api.md#video-inside-a-graphic-the-matte) for an
example module.

## Playback, rendering and memory

- **While playing forward**, Frame Job draws upcoming graphic frames on spare
  processor cores ahead of the playhead, and keeps frames it has drawn in
  memory while the window is open, so a stretch you play again comes from
  memory.
- **Background render**: when you leave Frame Job alone, the window you last
  used draws its graphics ahead of the paused playhead, so the next play is
  smooth from the start. A click, a key, an edit, or play, pause or seek in
  any Frame Job window (an agent's edits and playhead moves included) stops
  it at once, and it starts again after the same wait. Moving the pointer
  alone, or working in another app, doesn't stop it. It never runs while a
  window is playing, and it keeps the processor busy while it runs.

  | Setting (Settings ▸ Playback) | What it does | Default |
  |---|---|---|
  | Background render | Turns background drawing on or off | On |
  | Start after … seconds | How long Frame Job must be left alone first, 1–60 | 5 |

  See [Settings](settings.md).
- **Memory**: the drawn frames held ahead and kept use at most a quarter of
  your Mac's memory, and less when memory is short. They are let go when the
  window closes or newer frames replace them.
- **A graphic that fails** (its module is missing, doesn't compile, throws,
  or runs too long) draws a dark red error card with the error's text in
  place of the graphic, in the preview and in stills.
- **Time budget**: each frame has 250 ms to draw in the preview and 2 s in an
  export.
- **HDR projects**: in an HDR (HLG) project, graphics are drawn at HDR
  reference white (203 cd/m²), like titles and shapes, so a white graphic
  matches SDR white rather than reaching into the highlights. See
  [HDR and colour](hdr-and-color.md).

## Exporting

An export draws each graphic as its module stood when the export was queued.
Editing a module while an export runs doesn't change that file. See
[Export](export.md).

- An export that would draw a graphic whose module is missing or doesn't
  compile is not started. The message names each graphic and its first error.
- A graphic that fails partway through stops the export at that frame, names
  the graphic, and writes no file.
- Warnings a graphic gives while drawing don't stop the export. An agent's
  export result lists them as `graphic_warnings`.

## Limits

- A graphic draws at most 8192 pixels on a side.
- Properties show only when all the selected clips share one module, and
  Timeline only for a single clip.
- A clip stores at most 64 property values.
- Rename Graphic… is unavailable while a nest is open.
- Delete Graphic… is refused while any clip, including one inside a nest,
  uses the module.
- Only the last 10 versions of each module are kept.
- Frame Job watches the first 16 module, font and picture files one by one. In
  a folder with more, a save that rewrites a later file in place may not show
  until something else in the folder changes.
- The memory used for drawn frames is capped at a quarter of the Mac's.
```text
Math.random()        → Math.random is not available; use random(seed)
import x from "x"    → imports are not available in a graphic; the standard library is global
new Function("…")    → Function is not available in a graphic; the module is the one source of code
eval("…")            → ReferenceError: eval is not defined
```

`Date` is frozen: `Date.now()` is `946684800000` and `new Date()` is
2000-01-01T00:00:00Z. There is no `fetch`, file, clock, `performance`,
`WebAssembly` or `Intl`. Modern syntax works: template literals, `??`, `?.`,
`**`, destructuring, `Array.prototype.at`, `replaceAll`, `findLast`.

## Limits

- **Time**: each call has a budget — 250 ms per frame in preview, 2 s in an
  export. The module's top level has one too. Over it, the answer is an
  error such as `over the 250 ms budget at frame 12 (InternalError:
  interrupted)`.
- **Memory**: 64 MB of heap and 1 MB of stack per engine. Past either is an
  error with a line and column.
- **Size**: a graphic draws at most 8192 pixels on a side.
- **The answer**: `render` must return an SVG string. `undefined` is
  ``render returned undefined at frame 12 — did you forget `return`?``.
  The string may be at most 8 MiB (8388608 bytes); a longer one is
  `render returned 9000000 bytes at frame 12; the SVG may be at most
  8388608 bytes`.

## Diagnostics

Every problem comes back as `{level, message, line, column, frame}`.
`level` is `"error"` (nothing drew) or `"warning"` (it drew anyway).
`line` and `column` are the module's own, when known; for a timeout they
are where the function begins, not the statement that ran long. `frame` is
set for a problem found while drawing. A warning from the module's top level
(such as `asset("x")` outside `render`) has no frame, and comes back with the
module's compile: `ok` is still `true`.
`#ffffff` to `#00000000` is `#63636380`, grey and half transparent. While a prop
moves, every frame is drawn anew, so a graphic that had settled costs a full draw per frame for the
length of the action.

## Video inside a graphic: the matte

A graphic cannot read a video's pixels. To show video inside a shape the graphic draws, put the
graphic on the track directly above the video and switch that track to a **matte**: Track ▸ Matte
in the app, or `set_track {track, matte}` over MCP. A matte track's clips are never drawn. What
they show cuts the track directly behind: with `alpha`, the video shows where the graphic is
opaque; with `alpha_inverted`, where it is transparent; with `luma` and `luma_inverted`, by the
brightness of what it draws. `matte: "none"` turns it off. Where the matte track has no clip, the
video shows uncut. The module is written and called exactly as anywhere else. Fill the window in
white so it works in every mode, and animate it as usual: the cut follows each frame.

```js
export const meta = { name: "Window", durationInFrames: 90 };
export const schema = { radius: { type: "number", default: 24, min: 0, max: 200 } };

export function render(frame, props, ctx) {
  const t = spring({ frame, fps: ctx.fps, damping: 18 });
  const w = ctx.width * 0.6 * t;
  const h = ctx.height * 0.6 * t;
  return svg(ctx, `<rect x="${(ctx.width - w) / 2}" y="${(ctx.height - h) / 2}"
    width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="${props.radius}" fill="#ffffff"/>`);
}
```

On a matte track a clip's position, scale, opacity, crop and actions still shape the window. Its
blend mode, drop shadow and reflection do nothing. The matted video's own drop shadow follows the
cut-out shape.

Buttons:

301	// app/Sources/GraphicStore+History.swift — the kept revisions of a
302	// document's modules and the rename journal (spec §11 G-27, G-28, G-29).
303	//
304	// **On disk**, inside `graphics/`:
305	// `history/<name>/<%06d sequence>-<revision>.js` is one kept text — the next
306	// sequence is the highest plus one, and any other file there is ignored —
307	// and `history/renames.json` is a JSON array of `[a, b]` pairs (the app
308	// moved the file FROM `a` TO `b`; the repair only ever moves it back, G-28
309	// (e)), oldest first, at most `renameJournalLimit`, a repeated unordered
310	// pair moved to the end. Both are user content carried by every save (spec
311	// §5.6), never a cache.
312	//
313	// **`history/` is created only inside an existing `graphics/`** (G-14:
314	// `ensureFolder()` stays the one creator of the folder), with no
315	// `packageContentsDidChangeOnDisk()` call — `fonts/`'s precedent in
316	// `GraphicStore+Import.swift`.
317	//
318	// **History never holds the current text.** `keepReplaced`, which a pass
319	// calls on the store's queue before it stores its scan, keeps the bytes a
320	// module's new text replaced and drops the new text's own revision; a
321	// text kept twice is listed once, and the lowest sequences past
322	// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing is kept at `start()`, for a removal
323	// the app did not make, or for a text that came and went inside one pass;
324	// `start()` DROPS each module's current revision from its history (a text
325	// put back while the project was closed), which is a drop and not a keep.
326	//
327	// **A file-less name with kept revisions is a DELETED module** (G-27 (f);
328	// a rename killed part-way leaves the same state: G-28 (f)): `moveHistory`
329	// leaves no `history/<from>/` behind, which is what makes that test sound
330	// for `ProjectDocument.reconcileGraphicNames()`.
331	
332	import CryptoKit
333	import Foundation
334	
335	/// One kept text of a module: its revision (G-13), its place in the
336	/// module's history and its file.
337	struct GraphicKept: Equatable {
338	    let revision: String, sequence: Int, url: URL
339	}
340	
341	extension GraphicStore {
342	    static let historyFolderName = "history", renameJournalName = "renames.json"
343	    static let historyLimit = 10, renameJournalLimit = 32
344	
345	    // MARK: - Reading (main)
346	
347	    /// The kept texts of `name`, newest first, read from the disk; empty
348	    /// for a name that is not a module name.
349	    func kept(named name: String) -> [GraphicKept] {
350	        Array(Self.keptEntries(named: name, in: folderURL).reversed())
351	    }
352	
353	    /// The names holding at least one kept text, sorted — deleted modules
354	    /// included.
355	    func keptNames() -> [String] {
356	        let history = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(Self.historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
357	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: history.path)) ?? []
358	        return names.filter { !Self.keptEntries(named: $0, in: folderURL).isEmpty }.sorted()
359	    }
360	
361	    /// The journalled renames, newest first.
362	    func renamePairs() -> [(String, String)] {
363	        Self.journal(in: folderURL).reversed().map { ($0[0], $0[1]) }
364	    }
365	
366	    // MARK: - Writing (the store's queue, or main inside `onQueue`)
367	
368	    /// Keeps `bytes` as the newest text of `name`: an entry already holding
369	    /// that revision is removed first, then the lowest sequences past
370	    /// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing unless `folder` exists.
371	    static func keep(_ bytes: Data, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
372	        let files = FileManager.default
373	        guard isModuleName(name), files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
374	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
375	        try? files.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
376	        let revision = hex(SHA256.hash(data: bytes))
377	        let entries = keptEntries(named: name, in: folder)
378	        let next = (entries.last?.sequence ?? 0) + 1
379	        do {
380	            try bytes.write(
381	                to: directory.appendingPathComponent(entryName(next, revision)), options: .atomic)
382	        } catch {
383	            return
384	        }
385	        tidy(name, in: folder)
386	    }
387	
388	    /// Removes every kept entry of `name` holding `revision`.
389	    static func dropKept(revision: String, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
390	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder) where entry.revision == revision {
391	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: entry.url)
392	        }
393	        removeIfEmpty(historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder))
394	    }
395	
396	    /// One pass's history work, file work only: for every name in BOTH
397	    /// scans whose revision differs, the old scan's bytes are kept; for
398	    /// every name whose revision is new or changed, the current revision is
399	    /// dropped from its history.
400	    static func keepReplaced(from last: GraphicScan, to found: GraphicScan, in folder: URL) {
401	        for (name, module) in found.modules.sorted(by: { $0.key < $1.key }) {
402	            let old = last.modules[name]
403	            guard old?.revision != module.revision else { continue }
404	            if let old = old { keep(old.bytes, named: name, in: folder) }
405	            dropKept(revision: module.revision, named: name, in: folder)
406	        }
407	    }
408	
409	    /// `from`'s entries appended, in order, after `to`'s highest sequence,
410	    /// then pruned; `history/<from>/` is gone afterwards. A throw leaves
411	    /// both histories as they were.
412	    static func moveHistory(from: String, to: String, in folder: URL) throws {
413	        let files = FileManager.default
414	        let source = historyDirectory(of: from, in: folder)
415	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: source.path) else { return }
416	        let target = historyDirectory(of: to, in: folder)
417	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: target.path) else {
418	            try files.moveItem(at: source, to: target)
419	            return
420	        }
421	        var sequence = keptEntries(named: to, in: folder).last?.sequence ?? 0
422	        var moved: [(from: URL, to: URL)] = []
423	        do {
424	            for entry in keptEntries(named: from, in: folder) {
425	                sequence += 1
426	                let landed = target.appendingPathComponent(entryName(sequence, entry.revision))
427	                try files.moveItem(at: entry.url, to: landed)
428	                moved.append((entry.url, landed))
429	            }
430	            try files.removeItem(at: source)
431	        } catch {
432	            for pair in moved.reversed() { try? files.moveItem(at: pair.to, to: pair.from) }
433	            throw error
434	        }
435	        tidy(to, in: folder)
436	    }
437	
438	    /// Journals a rename: the pair appended, an earlier entry of the same
439	    /// unordered pair removed, the oldest dropped past `renameJournalLimit`.
440	    /// Nothing unless `folder` exists.
441	    static func recordRename(_ a: String, _ b: String, in folder: URL) {
442	        let files = FileManager.default
443	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
444	        var pairs = journal(in: folder).filter { Set($0) != Set([a, b]) }
445	        pairs.append([a, b])
446	        pairs = Array(pairs.suffix(renameJournalLimit))
447	        let history = folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
448	        try? files.createDirectory(at: history, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
449	        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: pairs) else { return }
450	        try? data.write(to: renameJournalURL(in: folder), options: .atomic)
451	    }
452	
453	    /// `history/renames.json` as it is on disk: its bytes, or nil when
454	    /// there is no file.
455	    static func renameJournalBytes(in folder: URL) -> Data? {
456	        try? Data(contentsOf: renameJournalURL(in: folder))
457	    }
458	
459	    /// Puts the journal back as `renameJournalBytes` read it: those bytes,
460	    /// or no file — what a rename refused after its pair was written does,
461	    /// at the fold (`moveModule`) or at the clips (`renameGraphic`'s move
462	    /// back), so a refused act journals nothing (G-28 (d)).
463	    static func putBackRenameJournal(_ bytes: Data?, in folder: URL) {
464	        let url = renameJournalURL(in: folder)
465	        if let bytes = bytes {
466	            try? bytes.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
467	        } else {
468	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)
469	        }
470	    }
471	
472	    // MARK: - The files
473	
474	    private static func renameJournalURL(in folder: URL) -> URL {
475	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
476	            .appendingPathComponent(renameJournalName)
477	    }
478	
479	    /// `history/<name>/` inside `folder`.
480	    static func historyDirectory(of name: String, in folder: URL) -> URL {
481	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
482	            .appendingPathComponent(name, isDirectory: true)
483	    }
484	
485	    private static func entryName(_ sequence: Int, _ revision: String) -> String {
486	        String(format: "%06d", sequence) + "-" + revision + ".js"
487	    }
488	
489	    /// The kept entries of `name`, oldest first: every
490	    /// `<sequence>-<64 hex digits>.js` in its directory.
491	    private static func keptEntries(named name: String, in folder: URL) -> [GraphicKept] {
492	        guard isModuleName(name) else { return [] }
493	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
494	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)) ?? []
495	        var entries: [GraphicKept] = []
496	        for file in names where file.hasSuffix(".js") {
497	            let parts = file.dropLast(3).split(separator: "-", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
498	            guard parts.count == 2, let sequence = Int(parts[0]), sequence > 0,
499	                parts[1].count == 64, parts[1].allSatisfy({ "0123456789abcdef".contains($0) })
500	            else { continue }
501	            entries.append(GraphicKept(
502	                revision: String(parts[1]), sequence: sequence,
503	                url: directory.appendingPathComponent(file)))
504	        }
505	        return entries.sorted { $0.sequence < $1.sequence }
506	    }
507	
508	    /// One revision once (its highest sequence), then at most
509	    /// `historyLimit` entries, the lowest sequences removed.
510	    private static func tidy(_ name: String, in folder: URL) {
511	        let files = FileManager.default
512	        var seen = Set<String>()
513	        var newestFirst: [GraphicKept] = []
514	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder).reversed() {
515	            if seen.insert(entry.revision).inserted {
516	                newestFirst.append(entry)
517	            } else {
518	                try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url)
519	            }
520	        }
521	        for entry in newestFirst.dropFirst(historyLimit) { try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url) }
522	    }
523	
524	    private static func removeIfEmpty(_ directory: URL) {
525	        let files = FileManager.default
526	        guard let names = try? files.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path), names.isEmpty
527	        else { return }
528	        try? files.removeItem(at: directory)
529	    }
530	
531	    /// The journal as written: every element that is a pair of strings.
532	    private static func journal(in folder: URL) -> [[String]] {
533	        guard let data = renameJournalBytes(in: folder),
534	            let pairs = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [Any]
535	        else { return [] }
536	        return pairs.compactMap { $0 as? [String] }.filter { $0.count == 2 }
537	    }
538	}
539	// app/Sources/GraphicStore+Manual.swift — the graphics reference written
540	// into a package's `graphics/` (road map 10's G4a): `API.md` and `API.d.ts`,
541	// copies of the app's bundled `GraphicsAPI.md` and `GraphicsAPI.d.ts`, so an
542	// agent or a person editing the folder has the API beside the modules.
543	//
544	// **The manual is never a reason to create `graphics/`** (spec §11 G-14):
545	// `writeManual()` writes nothing unless the folder already exists, and
546	// `holdsContent` does not count the manual, so an untitled root holding only
547	// the manual is not carried by a save.
548	
549	import Foundation
550	
551	extension GraphicStore {
552	    /// What the manual is called inside `graphics/`.
553	    static let manualNames = ["API.md", "API.d.ts"]
554	    /// What it is called in the app's Resources, in `manualNames`' order.
555	    static let bundledManualNames = ["GraphicsAPI.md", "GraphicsAPI.d.ts"]
556	
557	    /// The directory holding `Fonts/`, which holds the manual too. The
558	    /// harness copies the manual there; the probes copy none, so for them
559	    /// `writeManual()` is a no-op.
560	    static func manualDirectory(besideFonts fonts: URL) -> URL {
561	        fonts.deletingLastPathComponent()
562	    }

564	    var manualDirectory: URL { Self.manualDirectory(besideFonts: bundledFonts) }
565	
566	    /// The app bundle's own `GraphicsAPI.md`, no document involved:
567	    /// `graphic_reference` answers it and Help ▸ Graphics Reference opens it.
568	    static var bundledReferenceURL: URL {
569	        manualDirectory(besideFonts: ProjectDocument.bundledFontsDirectory)
570	            .appendingPathComponent(bundledManualNames[0])
571	    }

573	    /// Main. Nothing unless `folderURL` exists; each file written
574	    /// (`.atomic`) only when its bytes differ from the bundled one; a
575	    /// bundled file that is absent is skipped silently.
576	    func writeManual() {
577	        let files = FileManager.default
578	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: folderURL.path) else { return }
579	        for (bundled, name) in zip(Self.bundledManualNames, Self.manualNames) {
580	            guard let bytes = try? Data(
581	                contentsOf: manualDirectory.appendingPathComponent(bundled))
582	            else { continue }
583	            let target = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(name)
584	            if let current = try? Data(contentsOf: target), current == bytes { continue }
585	            try? bytes.write(to: target, options: .atomic)
586	        }
587	    }

589	    /// True when `folder` holds ANY entry, file or directory, that is
590	    /// neither hidden, one of `manualNames`, nor a `.partial`. A `fonts/` or
591	    /// `assets/` subfolder counts; `listing(_:)`'s regular-files rule is not
592	    /// this.
593	    static func holdsContent(_ folder: URL) -> Bool {
594	        let entries = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
595	            at: folder, includingPropertiesForKeys: nil,
596	            options: [.skipsHiddenFiles])) ?? []
597	        return entries.contains {
598	            !manualNames.contains($0.lastPathComponent) && $0.pathExtension != "partial"
599	        }
600	    }

602	// app/Sources/GraphicStore.swift — one document's `graphics/` folder: where
603	// it is, what is in it, and when that changes (road map 10 §5f, G3a). It
604	// scans, hashes (G-13) and says what changed; a file edit is not undo (G-3).
605	//
606	// **Created on the app's first write, never at open** (spec §11 G-14):
607	// `ensureFolder()` is the one creator inside a package; while it is absent
608	// the PACKAGE directory is watched, so an outside `mkdir` is seen.
609	//
610	// **The watch** is G0's q7(c): a folder source raises `.write` only and an
611	// in-place (`O_TRUNC`) save raises nothing on the folder, so each module,
612	// font and asset file up to `fileSourceLimit`, modules first (spec §11
613	// G-19 (c), G-20 (a)), has its own source; events are coalesced over 100 ms.
614	// Every pass re-opens every source BY PATH (a save swaps inodes) and arms
615	// BEFORE it scans. A source whose `open` fails is a scan warning (G-20 (b)).
616	// An illegal asset name is warned and skipped; fonts are `+Fonts`' (G-23).
617	//
618	// **Threading.** One serial queue alone touches the queue-confined state; it
619	// diffs, and main publishes in order through `drain()`. Main waits on the
620	// queue only through `queue.sync`; the queue never waits on main.
621	
622	import CryptoKit
623	import Foundation
624	
625	extension Notification.Name {
626	    /// Posted on main (object: the store) when modules were added, changed
627	    /// or removed, or the font and asset set moved. `userInfo[namesKey]`:
628	    /// the names, sorted (all of them when the library moved — so EMPTY
629	    /// when it moved in a folder holding no module); `[libraryKey]`:
630	    /// whether it moved.
631	    static let graphicsDidChange = Notification.Name("FrameJobGraphicsDidChange")
632	
633	    /// Posted on main by a `GraphicStore` (object: the store) when the first
634	    /// save, or a Save As, moved its folder (`packageDidMove(to:)`).
635	    static let graphicsLocationDidChange = Notification.Name(
636	        "FrameJobGraphicsLocationDidChange")
637	}
638	
639	final class GraphicStore {
640	    static let folderName = "graphics", fontsFolderName = "fonts", assetsFolderName = "assets"
641	    static let namesKey = "names", libraryKey = "library"
642	    /// G-6: the faces the engine loads from `graphics/fonts/`.
643	    static let fontExtensions: Set<String> = ["ttf", "otf"]
644	    /// §5a: the pictures resvg draws from `graphics/assets/`.
645	    static let assetExtensions: Set<String> = ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "svg", "svgz"]
646	    static let coalesceInterval: TimeInterval = 0.1
647	    /// The module, font and asset files one pass arms a source on: modules,
648	    /// then fonts, then assets, in listing order (spec §11 G-20 (a)).
649	    static let fileSourceLimit = 16
650	
651	    /// G-3's rule, `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`, mirrored from
652	    /// `model_graphic.rs`'s `check_name`; the core stays the validator.
653	    static func isModuleName(_ name: String) -> Bool {
654	        let scalars = Array(name.unicodeScalars)
655	        guard let head = scalars.first, scalars.count <= 63 else { return false }
656	        let lowerOrDigit = { (s: Unicode.Scalar) in
657	            ("a"..."z").contains(s) || ("0"..."9").contains(s)
658	        }
659	        return lowerOrDigit(head) && scalars.allSatisfy { lowerOrDigit($0) || $0 == "-" }
660	    }
661	
662	    private static let nameRule = "is not a module name (lowercase letters, digits and -, "
663	        + "starting with a letter or a digit, at most 63 characters)"
664	
665	    /// The core's own sentence for a bad name (`model_graphic.rs`).
666	    static func nameSentence(_ name: String) -> String {
667	        "graphic name \"\(name)\" \(nameRule)"
668	    }
669	
670	    static func hex<D: Digest>(_ digest: D) -> String {
671	        digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
672	    }
673	
674	    /// The app's bundled faces (`app/Resources/Fonts/`, G-6).
675	    let bundledFonts: URL
676	    /// The package, or nil for an untitled document.
677	    private(set) var package: URL?
678	    /// `<package>/graphics`, which the store creates only in
679	    /// `ensureFolder()`; or the untitled root, created at `start()`.
680	    private(set) var folderURL: URL
681	    /// The last published scan, written on main; locked because
682	    /// `module(named:)` and `makeLibrary()` may be called from any thread.
683	    private(set) var scan: GraphicScan {
684	        get { scanLock.withLock { storedScan } }
685	        set { scanLock.withLock { storedScan = newValue } }
686	    }
687	    /// Main; once per OBSERVED absent → present of `<package>/graphics`, made
688	    /// here or found. Never for the untitled root, never at `start()`.
689	    var folderDidAppear: (() -> Void)?
690	
691	    private var seed: URL?
692	    private let scanLock = NSLock()
693	    private var storedScan = GraphicScan.empty
694	    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.kgalligan.framejob.graphics")
695	
696	    private typealias Outcome = (
697	        scan: GraphicScan, names: [String], library: Bool, folderAppeared: Bool
698	    )
699	    // Queue-confined, all of it.
700	    private var generation = 0
701	    private var running = false
702	    private var sources: [DispatchSourceFileSystemObject] = []
703	    private var pending: DispatchWorkItem?
704	    private var lastScan = GraphicScan.empty
705	    private var folderPresent = false

881	    /// The module's compile, and `clip`'s first frame drawn and rasterized at
882	    /// the clip's own size — through the memo, and never recomputed while a
883	    /// live gesture runs.
884	    func report(
885	        for clip: ClipSnapshot, _ shared: Shared, libraryVersion: String
886	    ) -> GraphicClipReport {
887	        let module: GraphicModule, revision: String
888	        switch shared.entry {
889	        case nil:
890	            return GraphicClipReport(
891	                compile: [GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(shared.name)],
892	                render: [], frame: nil)
893	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _)?:
894	            return GraphicClipReport(compile: diagnostics, render: [], frame: nil)
895	        case .compiled(let compiled, let hash, _, _)?:
896	            module = compiled
897	            revision = hash
898	        }
899	        guard let graphic = clip.graphic, let document = binding.document else { return .empty }
900	        if document.isLiveEditing { return lastReports[clip.id] ?? .empty }
901	        guard let set = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey),
902	              let source = layerSource(of: clip),
903	              case .graphic(_, let hash, let frame, let propsJSON, let ctxJSON) = source
904	        else { return .empty }
905	        let key = [
906	            shared.name, revision, libraryVersion, hash, "\(graphic.width)×\(graphic.height)",
907	        ].joined(separator: "|")
908	        if let hit = reportMemo[key] {
909	            lastReports[clip.id] = hit
910	            return hit
911	        }
912	        var render: [GraphicDiagnostic] = []
913	        do {
914	            let drawn = try module.svg(
915	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
916	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs)
917	            render += drawn.warnings
918	            do {
919	                let raster = try set.library.rasterize(
920	                    drawn.svg, width: graphic.width, height: graphic.height)
921	                render += raster.warnings
922	            } catch {
923	                render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
924	            }
925	        } catch {
926	            render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
927	        }
928	        let report = GraphicClipReport(
929	            compile: module.compileWarnings, render: render, frame: frame)
930	        if reportMemo.count >= 64 { reportMemo.removeAll() }
931	        reportMemo[key] = report
932	        lastReports[clip.id] = report
933	        return report
934	    }

936	    /// `clip`'s layer source in the recipe at its start, through
937	    /// `layerMemo`: `recipe(at:)` is asked only on a miss, and the memo is
938	    /// emptied when the binding's project is another handle.
939	    func layerSource(of clip: ClipSnapshot) -> RecipeSourceRef? {
940	        guard let project = binding.project else { return nil }
941	        if project !== layerProject {
942	            layerMemo = [:]
943	            layerProject = project
944	        }
945	        if let hit = layerMemo[clip.id] { return hit }
946	        guard let layer = project.recipe(at: clip.start)?.layers
947	            .first(where: { $0.clip == clip.id })
948	        else { return nil }
949	        layerMemo[clip.id] = layer.source
950	        return layer.source
951	    }

963	        alert.informativeText =
964	            "The copy is written into the package's graphics/ folder and the selected clips "
965	            + "are drawn by it. Writing the file cannot be undone; switching the clips can."
966	        let field = NSTextField(string: suggestion)

968	        field.placeholderString = "Module name"

971	        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
972	        alert.window.initialFirstResponder = field
973	        guard alert.runModal() == .alertFirstButtonReturn else { return }
974	        let name = field.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
975	        func refuse(_ sentence: String) {
976	            NSAlert(error: NSError(
977	                domain: "FrameJob", code: 1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: sentence]))
978	                .runModal()
979	        }
980	        guard GraphicStore.isModuleName(name) else { return refuse(GraphicStore.nameSentence(name)) }
981	        guard !store.holdsModule(named: name) else {
982	            return refuse("graphics/\(name).js already exists")

984	        do {

986	        } catch {
987	            return refuse("graphics/\(name).js could not be written: \(error.localizedDescription)")
988	        }
989	        store.rescan()
990	        let clips = binding.graphicClips.map(\.id)
991	        binding.apply(
992	            "Duplicate Graphic",
993	            clips.isEmpty ? [] : [.setGraphicRaw(clips: clips, patch: ["name": name], schema: schema)])
994	    }

37	/// What the idle clock's door answered (`Playback.startBackgroundRender`).
38	enum BackgroundStart {
39	    case started
40	    case notNeeded
41	    /// Seeking, restoring, rebuilding, holding, or the start refused (a
42	    /// window plays): the clock runs again.
43	    case busy

46	/// The idle clock (spec §11 G-38 (b), (c)). Main only.
47	///
48	/// **Activity** restarts it and stops the running background pass at once:
49	/// every event in `activityEvents` the app receives (a local monitor, so
50	/// pointer motion alone and events in other apps do not count), every
51	/// `.projectDocumentDidChange` of any document (live ticks included), and
52	/// every `syncPrefetch` of any transport — play, pause, a rate change, a
53	/// seek — which also makes that transport `current`. An agent's call counts
54	/// only when it edits or moves a transport.
55	///
56	/// **At the delay** (read from the stored setting at every restart), with
57	/// the setting on and no transport playing, `current` is asked to start a
58	/// pass; a playing transport or `.busy` runs the clock again, `.notNeeded`
59	/// waits for the next activity. `current` is weak,
60	/// and an invalidated `Playback` has no item, so a late fire finds nothing.
61	final class BackgroundRender {
62	    static let shared = BackgroundRender()
63	    static let activityEvents: NSEvent.EventTypeMask = [
64	        .keyDown, .flagsChanged, .leftMouseDown, .leftMouseDragged, .rightMouseDown,
65	        .rightMouseDragged, .otherMouseDown, .otherMouseDragged, .scrollWheel, .magnify, .rotate,
66	        .swipe, .smartMagnify,
67	    ]
68	
69	    private weak var current: Playback?
70	    /// Every transport that has moved: none may play when a pass starts.
71	    private let transports = NSHashTable<Playback>.weakObjects()
72	    private var timer: Timer?
73	    private var monitor: Any?
74	    private var observer: NSObjectProtocol?
75	
76	    private init() {
77	        monitor = NSEvent.addLocalMonitorForEvents(matching: Self.activityEvents) {
78	            [weak self] event in
79	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
80	            return event
81	        }
82	        observer = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
83	            forName: .projectDocumentDidChange, object: nil, queue: nil
84	        ) { [weak self] _ in
85	            self?.noteActivity(from: nil)
86	        }
87	    }
88	
89	    /// Activity: `playback`, when given, becomes `current`; the running pass
90	    /// stops; the one timer restarts at the stored delay.
91	    func noteActivity(from playback: Playback?) {
92	        if let playback {
93	            current = playback
94	            transports.add(playback)
95	        }
96	        GraphicPrefetch.shared.stopBackground()
97	        restartClock()
98	    }
99	
100	    private func restartClock() {
101	        timer?.invalidate()
102	        let delay = TimeInterval(BackgroundRenderSettings.load().delaySeconds)
103	        timer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: delay, repeats: false) { [weak self] _ in
104	            self?.idle()
105	        }
106	    }
107	
108	    /// A window that plays — forward or in reverse, with graphics or
109	    /// without — runs the clock again (G-38 (c)).
110	    private func idle() {
111	        timer = nil
112	        guard BackgroundRenderSettings.load().enabled else { return }
113	        let playing = transports.allObjects.contains { $0.rate != 0 }
114	        if playing || current?.startBackgroundRender() == .busy { restartClock() }
115	    }
116	}

272	// app/Sources/GraphicPrefetch+Memory.swift — the graphic rasters' one memory
273	// budget and the frames a document keeps (spec §11 G-37, issue #127).
274	//
275	// **One budget for the process.** A quarter of physical memory covers every
276	// session's held rasters (export and playback) and the kept frames. A worker
277	// waits while the held rasters of all sessions reach it (`claim`); the kept
278	// frames give way, least recently used first, and never exceed the room the
279	// held rasters leave: every change to either trims them to
280	// `max(0, budget − held)`. Frames a background pass drew ahead (G-38) are
281	// marked and give way last. Memory pressure halves the budget (warning) or
282	// sets it to 0 (critical: nothing is kept and no worker claims).
283	//
284	// **Kept frames.** Only a `Playback`'s key keeps (`beginKeeping` in its
285	// `init`): each raster the compositor used, and each finished raster a worker
286	// made for that key when it leaves its slot, under its texture key. A raster
287	// is a function of its texture key (the SVG text, the size and the library's
288	// content hash), so a kept raster is the serial path's (G-26 (c)).
289	// `FrameJobGraphicKeepOff` (YES) keeps nothing.
290	//
291	// **The engine's image cache** (G-39) is sized from the same budget: a
292	// sixteenth of it at the level in force, set at launch and on every pressure
293	// change; `FrameJobGraphicImageCacheOff` (YES) sets it to 0.
294	//
295	// Everything here is guarded by `GraphicPrefetch.condition`; `KeptFrames`
296	// never locks.
297	
298	import Foundation
299	
300	/// The system's memory-pressure level, and the budget it allows.
301	enum MemoryPressure: String, CaseIterable {
302	    case normal, warning, critical
303	}
304	
305	extension MemoryPressure {
306	    /// A quarter of `physical` at normal, an eighth at warning, 0 at critical.
307	    func budget(physical: UInt64) -> Int {
308	        switch self {
309	        case .normal: return Int(clamping: physical / 4)
310	        case .warning: return Int(clamping: physical / 8)
311	        case .critical: return 0
312	        }
313	    }
314	}

316	/// The kept graphic rasters of every keeping key, least recently used first
317	/// out. Under `GraphicPrefetch.condition` only; never locks.
318	struct KeptFrames {
319	    private struct Name: Hashable {
320	        let key: Int
321	        let textureKey: String
322	    }
323	
324	    private struct Frame {
325	        let name: Name
326	        let raster: GraphicRaster
327	        var stamp: Int
328	    }
329	
330	    private var frames: [Name: Frame] = [:]
331	    /// Marked frame → the highest background frame index it serves (G-38).
332	    private var ahead: [Name: Int] = [:]
333	    /// Σ bytes of the marked frames.
334	    private(set) var aheadBytes = 0
335	    /// Marked frames `trim` pushed out while still marked, since the last
336	    /// report that reset it (`graphic_memory`'s `ahead_evicted`, G-38 (d)).
337	    var aheadEvicted = 0
338	    /// Every touch in order, oldest first from `head`; an element whose stamp
339	    /// is no longer its frame's is stale and skipped.
340	    private var order: [(name: Name, stamp: Int)] = []
341	    private var head = 0
342	    private var clock = 0
343	    /// Σ raster.bgra.count over the kept frames.
344	    private(set) var bytes = 0
345	
346	    var count: Int { frames.count }
347	
348	    func contains(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String) -> Bool {
349	        frames[Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)] != nil
350	    }
351	
352	    /// `key`'s raster for `textureKey`, touched; nil when none is kept.
353	    mutating func raster(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String) -> GraphicRaster? {
354	        guard let frame = frames[Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)] else { return nil }
355	        touch(frame.name)
356	        return frame.raster
357	    }
358	
359	    /// Keeps `raster` under `key` and `textureKey`; one already kept is only
360	    /// touched.
361	    mutating func insert(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String, _ raster: GraphicRaster) {
362	        let name = Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)
363	        if frames[name] != nil {
364	            touch(name)
365	            return
366	        }
367	        clock += 1
368	        frames[name] = Frame(name: name, raster: raster, stamp: clock)
369	        order.append((name, clock))
370	        bytes += raster.bgra.count
371	    }
372	
373	    /// Out until `bytes <= max(0, room)`: unmarked frames least recently used
374	    /// first, marked ones only after no unmarked frame is left (G-38 (d)).
375	    mutating func trim(toFit room: Int) {
376	        let limit = max(0, room)
377	        var index = head
378	        while bytes > limit, index < order.count {
379	            let (name, stamp) = order[index]
380	            index += 1
381	            guard let one = frames[name], one.stamp == stamp, ahead[name] == nil else { continue }
382	            trimOut(name)
383	        }
384	        while bytes > limit, head < order.count {
385	            let (name, stamp) = order[head]
386	            head += 1
387	            guard let frame = frames[name], frame.stamp == stamp else { continue }
388	            trimOut(name)
389	        }
390	        compact()
391	    }
392	
393	    /// `trim`'s eviction: a marked frame counted in `aheadEvicted`.
394	    private mutating func trimOut(_ name: Name) {
395	        if ahead[name] != nil { aheadEvicted += 1 }
396	        evict(name)
397	    }
398	
399	    /// Every frame of `key` out.
400	    mutating func drop(_ key: Int) {
401	        let gone = frames.keys.filter { $0.key == key }
402	        for name in gone { evict(name) }
403	        compact()
404	    }
405	
406	    /// Marks `key`'s kept frame for `textureKey` as drawn ahead, serving
407	    /// background frame `index`; the higher index stays. A kept frame only.
408	    mutating func markAhead(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String, index: Int) {
409	        let name = Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)
410	        guard let frame = frames[name] else { return }
411	        if let old = ahead[name] {
412	            ahead[name] = max(old, index)
413	        } else {
414	            ahead[name] = index
415	            aheadBytes += frame.raster.bgra.count
416	        }
417	    }
418	
419	    /// The marks whose index is below `index` out: the compositor passed them.
420	    mutating func clearAhead(below index: Int) {
421	        let passed = ahead.filter { $0.value < index }.map(\.key)
422	        for name in passed {
423	            ahead[name] = nil
424	            if let frame = frames[name] { aheadBytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count }
425	        }
426	    }
427	
428	    /// Every mark out.
429	    mutating func clearAhead() {
430	        ahead.removeAll()
431	        aheadBytes = 0
432	    }
433	
434	    /// `name`'s frame out, and its mark with it.
435	    private mutating func evict(_ name: Name) {
436	        guard let frame = frames.removeValue(forKey: name) else { return }
437	        bytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count
438	        if ahead.removeValue(forKey: name) != nil { aheadBytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count }
439	    }
440	
441	    private mutating func touch(_ name: Name) {
442	        clock += 1
443	        frames[name]?.stamp = clock
444	        order.append((name, clock))
445	        compact()
446	    }
447	
448	    /// The stale touches out once they outnumber the frames.
449	    private mutating func compact() {
450	        if frames.isEmpty {
451	            order.removeAll()
452	            head = 0
453	            return
454	        }
455	        guard order.count - head > 2 * frames.count + 64 else { return }
456	        order = order[head...].filter { frames[$0.name]?.stamp == $0.stamp }
457	        head = 0
458	    }
459	}

533	    /// A background pass from `key` at `startTicks` begins: every mark out,
534	    /// it is the origin (G-38 (d)), and Frame Job opts out of App Nap for

540	        endPassActivity()

542	            options: .userInitiatedAllowingIdleSystemSleep,
543	            reason: "Frame Job background render (spec §11 G-38)")

550	        passActivity = nil
551	    }

554	    /// starts where the last pass did, on its key. Under `condition`.
555	    func followAhead(_ key: Int, startTicks: Ticks) {
556	        if let origin = aheadOrigin, origin.key == key, origin.startTicks == startTicks { return }

569	    /// Whether a background pass can take `slots` without its marked frames

571	    /// pass ends `full` when not (G-38 (c)). Under `condition`.
572	    func roomAhead(for slots: [Slot]) -> Bool {
573	        kept.aheadBytes + heldTotal + slots.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.width * $1.height * 4 }
574	            <= budgetBytes

577	    /// A background session's one line (G-38 (c)); B is the marked bytes.

579	    func backgroundLine(
580	        key: Int, workers: Int, start: Ticks, frames: Int, counts: (drawn: Int, kept: Int),
581	        end: String
582	    ) -> String {
583	        "[framejob] graphic background: key \(key), \(workers) workers, from \(start), "

588	    /// The compositor used `raster` for `textureKey` on `key`: kept when `key`

590	    /// frames trimmed to that room.
591	    func keep(_ key: Int, textureKey: String, raster: GraphicRaster) {
592	        condition.lock()
593	        defer { condition.unlock() }
594	        guard keeping.contains(key), raster.bgra.count <= budgetBytes - heldTotal else { return }

599	    /// The memory-pressure level: the system's, or with `simulated` the dev
600	    /// tool's, which holds until it sets `.normal` (that clears it). The kept
601	    /// frames trimmed to the new budget, every waiting worker told, and the
602	    /// engine's image cache set to its new limit (G-39 (c)).
603	    func setPressure(_ level: MemoryPressure, simulated: Bool = false) {
604	        condition.lock()
605	        if simulated {
606	            simulatedPressure = level == .normal ? nil : level
607	        } else {
608	            pressure = level
609	        }
610	        kept.trim(toFit: budgetBytes - heldTotal)
611	        condition.broadcast()
612	        applyImageCacheLimit()
613	        condition.unlock()
614	    }

616	    /// The budget, the held rasters and the kept frames now; the peaks reset
617	    /// to the current totals when asked.

619	        condition.lock()
620	        defer { condition.unlock() }

622	            physicalBytes: Int(clamping: Self.physicalBytes), budgetBytes: budgetBytes,
623	            pressure: simulatedPressure ?? pressure, heldBytes: heldTotal,
624	            heldPeakBytes: heldPeakBytes, heldPeakEntries: heldPeakEntries,
625	            keptBytes: kept.bytes, keptFrames: kept.count, keptHits: keptHits,
626	            aheadBytes: kept.aheadBytes, aheadEvicted: kept.aheadEvicted,
627	            passActivity: passActivity != nil,
628	            imageCacheBytes: GraphicLibrary.imageCache(limit: imageCacheLimit),
629	            imageCacheLimit: imageCacheLimit)
630	        if resettingPeaks {
631	            heldPeakBytes = heldTotal
632	            heldPeakEntries = heldEntries
633	            kept.aheadEvicted = 0
634	        }

638	    /// One `DispatchSourceMemoryPressure` over normal, warning and critical,
639	    /// on a utility queue, for the process's life; then the engine's image
640	    /// cache gets its first limit (G-39 (c)).
641	    func watchMemoryPressure() {
642	        let source = DispatchSource.makeMemoryPressureSource(
643	            eventMask: [.normal, .warning, .critical], queue: .global(qos: .utility))
644	        source.setEventHandler { [weak self, weak source] in
645	            guard let self, let event = source?.data else { return }
646	            let level: MemoryPressure =
647	                event.contains(.critical)
648	                ? .critical : event.contains(.warning) ? .warning : .normal
649	            self.setPressure(level)
650	        }
651	        condition.lock()
652	        pressureSource = source
653	        condition.unlock()
654	        source.activate()
655	        condition.lock()
656	        applyImageCacheLimit()
657	        condition.unlock()
658	    }

660	// app/Sources/GraphicPrefetch.swift — an export's graphics, and a playing
661	// preview's, rasterized AHEAD of the compositor, on worker threads (spec §11
662	// G-26, G-36 and G-37, issue #127).
663	//
664	// **The compositor stays the one writer.** A worker runs a frame's graphic
665	// modules and rasterizes their SVG into a slot; the compositor still runs
666	// `svg` itself, records every warning and failure and draws every error card
667	// (G-8), and takes a slot's raster only on a pool miss and only when the
668	// worker's texture key equals its own (`LayerRenderersGraphic.swift`). So a
669	// worker can be wrong, late or absent and the file is still the serial
670	// path's, byte for byte.
671	//
672	// **Where it runs.** An `ExportWriter` export with a pinned set and a
673	// graphic in range (`Exporter.startGraphicPrefetch`), and a preview playing
674	// forward over a project that draws a graphic, on the document's own key
675	// (`Playback+Prefetch.swift`, G-36); never GIF/APNG, a one-frame render or a
676	// paused or reversing preview. `FrameJobGraphicPrefetchOff` (YES) is the
677	// measurement switch back to the serial path for both.
678	//
679	// **The grid.** A worker walks `range.start + i × frameDuration` on the
680	// export's own key: the core snaps the start onto the export's own grid
681	// from 0, at the export's rate after any override, so those are the
682	// instants the writer asks the compositor for. A playback session's grid
683	// starts at the seek target or the playhead, snapped down onto the
684	// composition's own grid from 0. A worker reads only through
685	// `RecipeSource.recipe(for:at:)` and `GraphicRegistry.resolve` — the
686	// export's PINNED set (G-13), or the document's — and never records a report.
687	//
688	// **Following.** A playback session `follows`: the compositor reports every
689	// request's time (`reach`), a worker never claims a frame at or before the
690	// last one reached (the frames passed over are `skipped`), and a held entry
691	// of an earlier frame goes as unused. A request outside the session's range
692	// is not followed, and a seek's session follows nothing until a request
693	// lands in its first `armFrames` frames: a seek installs the session before
694	// AVFoundation cancels the old position's requests, and those still served
695	// in between must not move the new session's floor. An export session never reads `floor`,
696	// `skipped` or `deferred`, and its log line is unchanged; a following one's
697	// appends `, playback from <start>, <skipped> skipped, <kept> kept`.
698	//
699	// **Bounds (G-37).** Bytes decide how far ahead workers go: a worker waits
700	// while the held rasters of ALL sessions reach the one process-wide budget
701	// (a quarter of physical memory, less under memory pressure), or while its
702	// session holds `entryCeiling` entries, bytes or none. A playing document's
703	// key KEEPS the frames it drew (`GraphicPrefetch+Memory.swift`): a finished
704	// raster leaving its slot goes into the kept frames, `take` answers from them
705	// before any slot, and a worker skips a texture key already kept. The kept
706	// frames fill only the room the held rasters leave.
707	//
708	// **One `NSCondition`** guards `sessions`, the kept frames, every total and
709	// every session and entry field, broadcast on every change (`CacheLedger`'s
710	// precedent). A worker never
711	// waits while it holds an unfinished entry, so the compositor's `take`, the
712	// one wait on its queue, always ends: on `done` or on `stop`. Each worker is
713	// a Foundation `Thread` with a stack above the engine's own 1 MiB; its
714	// QuickJS engines die with it.
715	
716	import CoreGraphics
717	import CoreMedia
718	import Foundation
719	
720	final class GraphicPrefetch: @unchecked Sendable {
721	    static let shared = GraphicPrefetch()
722	    /// YES draws every graphic on the compositor's queue alone.
723	    static let offDefaultsKey = "FrameJobGraphicPrefetchOff"
724	    /// Above `graphic::STACK_BYTES` (1 MiB).
725	    static let workerStackBytes = 8 << 20
726	    static var workerCount: Int { max(1, ProcessInfo.processInfo.activeProcessorCount - 1) }
727	    /// The entries one session holds at most, bytes or none (G-37 (a)).
728	    static let entryCeiling = 1024
729	
730	    /// One slot's raster as a worker made it. Guarded by `condition`.
731	    private final class Entry {
732	        let index: Int
733	        var bytes: Int
734	        var done = false
735	        /// Set by the worker's same-texture shortcut: the raster is left to
736	        /// the compositor's pool, from an earlier frame's entry.
737	        var deferred = false
738	        var textureKey: String?
739	        var raster: Result<GraphicRaster, any Error>?
740	        /// A pass's later layers deferred to this entry, and their top index.
741	        var sharers = 0, sharedUpTo = 0
742	
743	        init(index: Int, bytes: Int) {
744	            self.index = index
745	            self.bytes = bytes
746	        }
747	    }
748	
749	    /// One export's prefetch. Guarded by `condition`; its workers hold it
750	    /// after `stop` has removed it from `sessions`.
751	    private final class Session: @unchecked Sendable {
752	        let key: Int
753	        let start: CMTime
754	        let frameDuration: CMTime

301	// app/Sources/GraphicStore+History.swift — the kept revisions of a
302	// document's modules and the rename journal (spec §11 G-27, G-28, G-29).
303	//
304	// **On disk**, inside `graphics/`:
305	// `history/<name>/<%06d sequence>-<revision>.js` is one kept text — the next
306	// sequence is the highest plus one, and any other file there is ignored —
307	// and `history/renames.json` is a JSON array of `[a, b]` pairs (the app
308	// moved the file FROM `a` TO `b`; the repair only ever moves it back, G-28
309	// (e)), oldest first, at most `renameJournalLimit`, a repeated unordered
310	// pair moved to the end. Both are user content carried by every save (spec
311	// §5.6), never a cache.
312	//
313	// **`history/` is created only inside an existing `graphics/`** (G-14:
314	// `ensureFolder()` stays the one creator of the folder), with no
315	// `packageContentsDidChangeOnDisk()` call — `fonts/`'s precedent in
316	// `GraphicStore+Import.swift`.
317	//
318	// **History never holds the current text.** `keepReplaced`, which a pass
319	// calls on the store's queue before it stores its scan, keeps the bytes a
320	// module's new text replaced and drops the new text's own revision; a
321	// text kept twice is listed once, and the lowest sequences past
322	// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing is kept at `start()`, for a removal
323	// the app did not make, or for a text that came and went inside one pass;
324	// `start()` DROPS each module's current revision from its history (a text
325	// put back while the project was closed), which is a drop and not a keep.
326	//
327	// **A file-less name with kept revisions is a DELETED module** (G-27 (f);
328	// a rename killed part-way leaves the same state: G-28 (f)): `moveHistory`
329	// leaves no `history/<from>/` behind, which is what makes that test sound
330	// for `ProjectDocument.reconcileGraphicNames()`.
331	
332	import CryptoKit
333	import Foundation
334	
335	/// One kept text of a module: its revision (G-13), its place in the
336	/// module's history and its file.
337	struct GraphicKept: Equatable {
338	    let revision: String, sequence: Int, url: URL
339	}
340	
341	extension GraphicStore {
342	    static let historyFolderName = "history", renameJournalName = "renames.json"
343	    static let historyLimit = 10, renameJournalLimit = 32
344	
345	    // MARK: - Reading (main)
346	
347	    /// The kept texts of `name`, newest first, read from the disk; empty
348	    /// for a name that is not a module name.
349	    func kept(named name: String) -> [GraphicKept] {
350	        Array(Self.keptEntries(named: name, in: folderURL).reversed())
351	    }
352	
353	    /// The names holding at least one kept text, sorted — deleted modules
354	    /// included.
355	    func keptNames() -> [String] {
356	        let history = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(Self.historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
357	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: history.path)) ?? []
358	        return names.filter { !Self.keptEntries(named: $0, in: folderURL).isEmpty }.sorted()
359	    }
360	
361	    /// The journalled renames, newest first.
362	    func renamePairs() -> [(String, String)] {
363	        Self.journal(in: folderURL).reversed().map { ($0[0], $0[1]) }
364	    }
365	
366	    // MARK: - Writing (the store's queue, or main inside `onQueue`)
367	
368	    /// Keeps `bytes` as the newest text of `name`: an entry already holding
369	    /// that revision is removed first, then the lowest sequences past
370	    /// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing unless `folder` exists.
371	    static func keep(_ bytes: Data, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
372	        let files = FileManager.default
373	        guard isModuleName(name), files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
374	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
375	        try? files.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
376	        let revision = hex(SHA256.hash(data: bytes))
377	        let entries = keptEntries(named: name, in: folder)
378	        let next = (entries.last?.sequence ?? 0) + 1
379	        do {
380	            try bytes.write(
381	                to: directory.appendingPathComponent(entryName(next, revision)), options: .atomic)
382	        } catch {
383	            return
384	        }
385	        tidy(name, in: folder)
386	    }
387	
388	    /// Removes every kept entry of `name` holding `revision`.
389	    static func dropKept(revision: String, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
390	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder) where entry.revision == revision {
391	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: entry.url)
392	        }
393	        removeIfEmpty(historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder))
394	    }
395	
396	    /// One pass's history work, file work only: for every name in BOTH
397	    /// scans whose revision differs, the old scan's bytes are kept; for
398	    /// every name whose revision is new or changed, the current revision is
399	    /// dropped from its history.
400	    static func keepReplaced(from last: GraphicScan, to found: GraphicScan, in folder: URL) {
401	        for (name, module) in found.modules.sorted(by: { $0.key < $1.key }) {
402	            let old = last.modules[name]
403	            guard old?.revision != module.revision else { continue }
404	            if let old = old { keep(old.bytes, named: name, in: folder) }
405	            dropKept(revision: module.revision, named: name, in: folder)
406	        }
407	    }
408	
409	    /// `from`'s entries appended, in order, after `to`'s highest sequence,
410	    /// then pruned; `history/<from>/` is gone afterwards. A throw leaves
411	    /// both histories as they were.
412	    static func moveHistory(from: String, to: String, in folder: URL) throws {
413	        let files = FileManager.default
414	        let source = historyDirectory(of: from, in: folder)
415	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: source.path) else { return }
416	        let target = historyDirectory(of: to, in: folder)
417	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: target.path) else {
418	            try files.moveItem(at: source, to: target)
419	            return
420	        }
421	        var sequence = keptEntries(named: to, in: folder).last?.sequence ?? 0
422	        var moved: [(from: URL, to: URL)] = []
423	        do {
424	            for entry in keptEntries(named: from, in: folder) {
425	                sequence += 1
426	                let landed = target.appendingPathComponent(entryName(sequence, entry.revision))
427	                try files.moveItem(at: entry.url, to: landed)
428	                moved.append((entry.url, landed))
429	            }
430	            try files.removeItem(at: source)
431	        } catch {
432	            for pair in moved.reversed() { try? files.moveItem(at: pair.to, to: pair.from) }
433	            throw error
434	        }
435	        tidy(to, in: folder)
436	    }
437	
438	    /// Journals a rename: the pair appended, an earlier entry of the same
439	    /// unordered pair removed, the oldest dropped past `renameJournalLimit`.
440	    /// Nothing unless `folder` exists.
441	    static func recordRename(_ a: String, _ b: String, in folder: URL) {
442	        let files = FileManager.default
443	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
444	        var pairs = journal(in: folder).filter { Set($0) != Set([a, b]) }
445	        pairs.append([a, b])
446	        pairs = Array(pairs.suffix(renameJournalLimit))
447	        let history = folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
448	        try? files.createDirectory(at: history, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
449	        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: pairs) else { return }
450	        try? data.write(to: renameJournalURL(in: folder), options: .atomic)
451	    }
452	
453	    /// `history/renames.json` as it is on disk: its bytes, or nil when
454	    /// there is no file.
455	    static func renameJournalBytes(in folder: URL) -> Data? {
456	        try? Data(contentsOf: renameJournalURL(in: folder))
457	    }
458	
459	    /// Puts the journal back as `renameJournalBytes` read it: those bytes,
460	    /// or no file — what a rename refused after its pair was written does,
461	    /// at the fold (`moveModule`) or at the clips (`renameGraphic`'s move
462	    /// back), so a refused act journals nothing (G-28 (d)).
463	    static func putBackRenameJournal(_ bytes: Data?, in folder: URL) {
464	        let url = renameJournalURL(in: folder)
465	        if let bytes = bytes {
466	            try? bytes.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
467	        } else {
468	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)
469	        }
470	    }
471	
472	    // MARK: - The files
473	
474	    private static func renameJournalURL(in folder: URL) -> URL {
475	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
476	            .appendingPathComponent(renameJournalName)
477	    }
478	
479	    /// `history/<name>/` inside `folder`.
480	    static func historyDirectory(of name: String, in folder: URL) -> URL {
481	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
482	            .appendingPathComponent(name, isDirectory: true)
483	    }
484	
485	    private static func entryName(_ sequence: Int, _ revision: String) -> String {
486	        String(format: "%06d", sequence) + "-" + revision + ".js"
487	    }
488	
489	    /// The kept entries of `name`, oldest first: every
490	    /// `<sequence>-<64 hex digits>.js` in its directory.
491	    private static func keptEntries(named name: String, in folder: URL) -> [GraphicKept] {
492	        guard isModuleName(name) else { return [] }
493	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
494	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)) ?? []
495	        var entries: [GraphicKept] = []
496	        for file in names where file.hasSuffix(".js") {
497	            let parts = file.dropLast(3).split(separator: "-", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
498	            guard parts.count == 2, let sequence = Int(parts[0]), sequence > 0,
499	                parts[1].count == 64, parts[1].allSatisfy({ "0123456789abcdef".contains($0) })
500	            else { continue }
501	            entries.append(GraphicKept(
502	                revision: String(parts[1]), sequence: sequence,
503	                url: directory.appendingPathComponent(file)))
504	        }
505	        return entries.sorted { $0.sequence < $1.sequence }
506	    }
507	
508	    /// One revision once (its highest sequence), then at most
509	    /// `historyLimit` entries, the lowest sequences removed.
510	    private static func tidy(_ name: String, in folder: URL) {
511	        let files = FileManager.default
512	        var seen = Set<String>()
513	        var newestFirst: [GraphicKept] = []
514	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder).reversed() {
515	            if seen.insert(entry.revision).inserted {
516	                newestFirst.append(entry)
517	            } else {
518	                try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url)
519	            }
520	        }
521	        for entry in newestFirst.dropFirst(historyLimit) { try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url) }
522	    }
523	
524	    private static func removeIfEmpty(_ directory: URL) {
525	        let files = FileManager.default
526	        guard let names = try? files.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path), names.isEmpty
527	        else { return }
528	        try? files.removeItem(at: directory)
529	    }
530	
531	    /// The journal as written: every element that is a pair of strings.

888	        switch shared.entry {
889	        case nil:

891	                compile: [GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(shared.name)],

896	            module = compiled
897	            revision = hash

899	        guard let graphic = clip.graphic, let document = binding.document else { return .empty }
900	        if document.isLiveEditing { return lastReports[clip.id] ?? .empty }
901	        guard let set = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey),
902	              let source = layerSource(of: clip),
903	              case .graphic(_, let hash, let frame, let propsJSON, let ctxJSON) = source
904	        else { return .empty }
905	        let key = [
906	            shared.name, revision, libraryVersion, hash, "\(graphic.width)×\(graphic.height)",
907	        ].joined(separator: "|")
908	        if let hit = reportMemo[key] {
909	            lastReports[clip.id] = hit
910	            return hit
911	        }
912	        var render: [GraphicDiagnostic] = []
913	        do {
914	            let drawn = try module.svg(
915	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
916	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs)
917	            render += drawn.warnings
918	            do {

920	                    drawn.svg, width: graphic.width, height: graphic.height)

46	/// The idle clock (spec §11 G-38 (b), (c)). Main only.

49	/// every event in `activityEvents` the app receives (a local monitor, so
50	/// pointer motion alone and events in other apps do not count), every
51	/// `.projectDocumentDidChange` of any document (live ticks included), and
52	/// every `syncPrefetch` of any transport — play, pause, a rate change, a
53	/// seek — which also makes that transport `current`. An agent's call counts
54	/// only when it edits or moves a transport.

57	/// the setting on and no transport playing, `current` is asked to start a
58	/// pass; a playing transport or `.busy` runs the clock again, `.notNeeded`

272	// app/Sources/GraphicPrefetch+Memory.swift — the graphic rasters' one memory
273	// budget and the frames a document keeps (spec §11 G-37, issue #127).
274	//
275	// **One budget for the process.** A quarter of physical memory covers every
276	// session's held rasters (export and playback) and the kept frames. A worker
277	// waits while the held rasters of all sessions reach it (`claim`); the kept
278	// frames give way, least recently used first, and never exceed the room the
279	// held rasters leave: every change to either trims them to
280	// `max(0, budget − held)`. Frames a background pass drew ahead (G-38) are
281	// marked and give way last. Memory pressure halves the budget (warning) or
282	// sets it to 0 (critical: nothing is kept and no worker claims).
283	//
284	// **Kept frames.** Only a `Playback`'s key keeps (`beginKeeping` in its
285	// `init`): each raster the compositor used, and each finished raster a worker
286	// made for that key when it leaves its slot, under its texture key. A raster
287	// is a function of its texture key (the SVG text, the size and the library's
288	// content hash), so a kept raster is the serial path's (G-26 (c)).
289	// `FrameJobGraphicKeepOff` (YES) keeps nothing.
290	//
291	// **The engine's image cache** (G-39) is sized from the same budget: a
292	// sixteenth of it at the level in force, set at launch and on every pressure
293	// change; `FrameJobGraphicImageCacheOff` (YES) sets it to 0.
294	//
295	// Everything here is guarded by `GraphicPrefetch.condition`; `KeptFrames`
296	// never locks.
297	
298	import Foundation
299	
300	/// The system's memory-pressure level, and the budget it allows.
301	enum MemoryPressure: String, CaseIterable {
302	    case normal, warning, critical
303	}
304	
305	extension MemoryPressure {
306	    /// A quarter of `physical` at normal, an eighth at warning, 0 at critical.
307	    func budget(physical: UInt64) -> Int {
308	        switch self {
309	        case .normal: return Int(clamping: physical / 4)
310	        case .warning: return Int(clamping: physical / 8)
311	        case .critical: return 0
312	        }
313	    }
314	}
315	
316	/// The kept graphic rasters of every keeping key, least recently used first
317	/// out. Under `GraphicPrefetch.condition` only; never locks.
318	struct KeptFrames {
319	    private struct Name: Hashable {
320	        let key: Int
321	        let textureKey: String
322	    }
323	
324	    private struct Frame {
325	        let name: Name
326	        let raster: GraphicRaster
327	        var stamp: Int
328	    }
329	
330	    private var frames: [Name: Frame] = [:]
331	    /// Marked frame → the highest background frame index it serves (G-38).
332	    private var ahead: [Name: Int] = [:]
333	    /// Σ bytes of the marked frames.
334	    private(set) var aheadBytes = 0
335	    /// Marked frames `trim` pushed out while still marked, since the last
336	    /// report that reset it (`graphic_memory`'s `ahead_evicted`, G-38 (d)).
337	    var aheadEvicted = 0
338	    /// Every touch in order, oldest first from `head`; an element whose stamp
339	    /// is no longer its frame's is stale and skipped.
340	    private var order: [(name: Name, stamp: Int)] = []
341	    private var head = 0
342	    private var clock = 0
343	    /// Σ raster.bgra.count over the kept frames.
344	    private(set) var bytes = 0
345	
346	    var count: Int { frames.count }
347	
348	    func contains(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String) -> Bool {
349	        frames[Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)] != nil
350	    }
351	
352	    /// `key`'s raster for `textureKey`, touched; nil when none is kept.
353	    mutating func raster(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String) -> GraphicRaster? {
354	        guard let frame = frames[Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)] else { return nil }
355	        touch(frame.name)
356	        return frame.raster
357	    }
358	
359	    /// Keeps `raster` under `key` and `textureKey`; one already kept is only
360	    /// touched.
361	    mutating func insert(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String, _ raster: GraphicRaster) {
362	        let name = Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)
363	        if frames[name] != nil {
364	            touch(name)
365	            return
366	        }
367	        clock += 1
368	        frames[name] = Frame(name: name, raster: raster, stamp: clock)
369	        order.append((name, clock))
370	        bytes += raster.bgra.count
371	    }
372	
373	    /// Out until `bytes <= max(0, room)`: unmarked frames least recently used
374	    /// first, marked ones only after no unmarked frame is left (G-38 (d)).
375	    mutating func trim(toFit room: Int) {
376	        let limit = max(0, room)
377	        var index = head
378	        while bytes > limit, index < order.count {
379	            let (name, stamp) = order[index]
380	            index += 1
381	            guard let one = frames[name], one.stamp == stamp, ahead[name] == nil else { continue }
382	            trimOut(name)
383	        }
384	        while bytes > limit, head < order.count {
385	            let (name, stamp) = order[head]
386	            head += 1
387	            guard let frame = frames[name], frame.stamp == stamp else { continue }
388	            trimOut(name)
389	        }
390	        compact()
391	    }
392	
393	    /// `trim`'s eviction: a marked frame counted in `aheadEvicted`.
394	    private mutating func trimOut(_ name: Name) {
395	        if ahead[name] != nil { aheadEvicted += 1 }
396	        evict(name)
397	    }
398	
399	    /// Every frame of `key` out.
400	    mutating func drop(_ key: Int) {
401	        let gone = frames.keys.filter { $0.key == key }
402	        for name in gone { evict(name) }
403	        compact()
404	    }
405	
406	    /// Marks `key`'s kept frame for `textureKey` as drawn ahead, serving
407	    /// background frame `index`; the higher index stays. A kept frame only.
408	    mutating func markAhead(_ key: Int, _ textureKey: String, index: Int) {
409	        let name = Name(key: key, textureKey: textureKey)
410	        guard let frame = frames[name] else { return }
411	        if let old = ahead[name] {
412	            ahead[name] = max(old, index)
413	        } else {
414	            ahead[name] = index
415	            aheadBytes += frame.raster.bgra.count
416	        }
417	    }
418	
419	    /// The marks whose index is below `index` out: the compositor passed them.
420	    mutating func clearAhead(below index: Int) {
421	        let passed = ahead.filter { $0.value < index }.map(\.key)
422	        for name in passed {
423	            ahead[name] = nil
424	            if let frame = frames[name] { aheadBytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count }
425	        }
426	    }
427	
428	    /// Every mark out.
429	    mutating func clearAhead() {
430	        ahead.removeAll()
431	        aheadBytes = 0
432	    }
433	
434	    /// `name`'s frame out, and its mark with it.
435	    private mutating func evict(_ name: Name) {
436	        guard let frame = frames.removeValue(forKey: name) else { return }
437	        bytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count
438	        if ahead.removeValue(forKey: name) != nil { aheadBytes -= frame.raster.bgra.count }
439	    }
440	
441	    private mutating func touch(_ name: Name) {
442	        clock += 1
443	        frames[name]?.stamp = clock
444	        order.append((name, clock))
445	        compact()
446	    }
447	
448	    /// The stale touches out once they outnumber the frames.
449	    private mutating func compact() {
450	        if frames.isEmpty {
451	            order.removeAll()
452	            head = 0
453	            return
454	        }
455	        guard order.count - head > 2 * frames.count + 64 else { return }
456	        order = order[head...].filter { frames[$0.name]?.stamp == $0.stamp }
457	        head = 0
458	    }
459	}

533	    /// A background pass from `key` at `startTicks` begins: every mark out,

543	            reason: "Frame Job background render (spec §11 G-38)")

677	// measurement switch back to the serial path for both.

680	// export's own key: the core snaps the start onto the export's own grid
